name: Minneapolis Parks Teen Teamworks
what_you_do: Do work experiences with the Park Board. They teach work skills, decision making, communication and a good work ethic. Photo captions on the page show crews doing garden, painting and sign install projects.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 14 to 18. The page does not list other rules.
pay_detail: The page lists this under Youth Employment and Training Initiatives but does not say whether Teen Teamworks is paid or give a pay rate. Ask the Park Board.
duration: Not stated (the page only mentions a '2026 season')
deadline_text: The page says applications for the 2026 season are closed. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Watch the Youth Employment and Training Initiatives page and the Park Board temporary jobs page (minneapolisparks.org/jobs/temporary_jobs/) for the next application.
notes: Pay, season and hours are not stated on the page, so ask the Park Board before you plan. The same page lists Minneapolis Park Corps for ages 18 to 24 as paid training (not for teens). The Park Board teen page also lists Youthline, a mentorship program for ages 12 to 17. Minnesota work permit rules were not checked.
